rules.title: Const generic param baked to literal in spec clone
rules.statement: When a value parameter is specialized to a compile-time const argument, every read of that parameter in the monomorphized body is replaced by a literal of the parameter's substituted type: an integer literal for scalar const args, or an enum literal (enum_name, variant, discriminant) for enum-typed const args.

rules.title: Variable references preserve var slot across mono
rules.statement: A non-specialized variable reference is cloned as a VarRef carrying the (substituted) type and the original variable slot, so that post-monomorphization passes retain slot identity rather than re-keying by name.

rules.title: sizeof/alignof operand type is substituted
rules.statement: sizeof(T) and alignof(T) are monomorphized by substituting type variables in T with the instance's type arguments before emitting the size/align query; the result type is unchanged.

rules.title: Generic function reference resolved to mangled instantiation
rules.statement: A reference to a generic function with type arguments is monomorphized by substituting its type arguments, mangling base+args into a concrete symbol, scheduling that instantiation for emission, and rewriting the node into a plain VarRef carrying the mangled symbol and the substituted function-pointer type; later passes never observe a GenericRef.

rules.title: Custom-DST sized prefix field re-lowered per instantiation
rules.statement: When a field-read receiver monomorphizes to a custom-DST fat pointer (DstRef) and the field is a sized prefix field at byte offset off, the access is re-emitted as a typed deref of (data_half + off) rather than a thin struct GEP.
rules.uncertainty: Field layout offset computed by mono_dst_prefix_field (defined elsewhere); rule states observable result.

rules.title: Custom-DST unsized slice tail projects to fat slice
rules.statement: For a custom-DST receiver, an unsized slice tail field projects to a slice value `&[U]` whose data pointer is (data_half + off) cast to `*U` and whose length is the receiver fat pointer's metadata half.

rules.title: Custom-DST unsized dyn tail projects to fat dyn
rules.statement: For a custom-DST receiver, an unsized dyn (UnsizedDyn, or borrow-owned TraitObject) tail field projects to a `&dyn Trait` value whose data pointer is (data_half + off) and whose metadata is the receiver fat pointer's vtable (metadata half), retyped as TraitObject with the field's trait name and type-args carried over.

rules.title: Array-literal pack expansion
rules.statement: An array element that is a parameter-pack expansion is monomorphized by expanding it to one element per pack member: a const pack yields per-member integer literals; a type/value pack yields per-member VarRefs named by the pack arg naming scheme.

rules.title: Fill-array `[v; sizeof...(P)]` repeats value N times
rules.statement: A single-element fill array literal whose array length type variable substitutes to N>1 is monomorphized by re-substituting the source value expression N times so the resulting array has N elements.

rules.title: Closure call to a substituted fn-value becomes a fn-pointer call
rules.statement: A ClosureCall whose callee monomorphizes to a function-value type (fn pointer / Fn-family bound resolved to a concrete fn value) is rewritten to a direct function-pointer call.

rules.title: Closure call to a struct implementing Fn-family routes to its call method
rules.statement: A ClosureCall whose callee monomorphizes to a (zoned) struct that implements an Fn/FnMut/FnOnce trait is rewritten to a method call on that struct: the receiver is prepended as the self argument, and the called method is the first of `call`, `call_mut`, `call_once` for which an impl method exists (defaulting to `call`), resolved on the concrete struct name including type-args.

rules.title: Unary operator on struct dispatches to overload method
rules.statement: After substitution, a unary operator whose operand is a struct is rewritten to a call to the struct's operator method: `-` -> `neg`, `!` -> `not`; resolved on the concrete struct name within the struct's package.
rules.divergence: T2-15: the logical-not overload method is named `not` (not Rust `Not::not` symbol but conformant in spirit); note earlier name was `not_`.

rules.title: Binary operator on struct dispatches to overload method
rules.statement: After substitution, a binary operator whose left operand is a struct is rewritten to a two-argument call to the struct's operator method: + add, - sub, * mul, / div, % rem, == eq, != ne, < lt, <= le, > gt, >= ge; resolved on the concrete struct name within the struct's package.

rules.title: reflect_of on a non-generic zoned struct registers a reflect request
rules.statement: When reflect_of(T) monomorphizes to a ZonedStruct with no type arguments, the struct's fully-qualified name (pkg::name) is recorded as a reflect request for the emitted program.
